2.title: How Iran Adapted Its Attacks as U.S. War Munitions Dwindled
2.summary: The Iranian strikes that killed three U.S. soldiers in Jordan show how quickly Iran’s war-fighting skills have evolved, as the Pentagon runs low on interceptors.

3.title: University of Michigan Will Ease Up on Grades for Student Mental Health
3.summary: The University of Michigan will make first-semester grades pass or fail, to encourage students to try different classes and lessen fears of the consequences of a low grade.

5.title: After Deadly Earthquake in Colombia, a Late-Night Hunt for Survivors
5.summary: “We heard them screaming,” said one rescuer in Cali, where rescuers face a race against time to find the living.

6.title: What We Know About the Earthquake in Colombia
6.summary: The 7.4-magnitude quake, which killed more than 100 people and damaged hundreds of buildings, was the strongest recorded in Colombia in a decade.
